products.name: Corporate bond new-issue feed
products.description: Poll EDGAR per-CIK 424B2/424B5/424B3/FWP, parse tranche tables (coupon, maturity, size, price, discount, bookrunners, use of proceeds) into JSON, link to EX-FILING FEES XBRL for exact amounts. Alert within minutes of filing.
products.buyers: Credit funds, bond ETF desks, treasury teams, fintech apps, sell-side credit sales
products.decision_supported: Which issuer came to market, size, tenor curve, new-issue concession
products.latency: minutes (EDGAR acceptance); bond pricing happens 1-4 days earlier via FWP
products.competitors: Bloomberg NIM, Refinitiv, Mergent FISD, Octus, Selectica; free: EDGAR full-text
products.legal_notes: EDGAR public domain. Do not scrape CUSIPs for resale as CGS database (CUSIP Global Services licence applies); ISIN derived from CUSIP is also restricted in redistribution.

forms.suggestion: Ship a 'new bond issue' event in the Provenance event feed: on any 424B2/424B5 or FWP from a tracked CIK, emit tranches[] (title, principal, coupon, maturity, price, underwriter discount) parsed from HTML, plus fee exhibit totals as a cross-check.
caveats: Prospectus body is not XBRL: tranche extraction is HTML parsing; WebFetch summaries read only first 100,000 characters of each document.

Filing-fee exhibit (EX-FILING FEES) is inline XBRL with a companion *_htm.xml file in each 2024+ 424B folder; fee rate 0.000087 (MSFT Nov 2026) and 0.0001381 (BRK Apr 2026) differ by fiscal-year SEC fee rate.
Microsoft and Alphabet 424B2 do not state the Treasury benchmark; spread is only in the FWP.
Berkshire euro notes not found in last 10 424B5 results; only yen verified.
